out.other_title: Process supervision (step-level feedback) outperforms outcome supervision on MATH
out.rationale: Lightman et al. report process supervision significantly outperforms outcome supervision for training models to solve problems from the MATH dataset. text: The paper reports that among RL methods PPO is most effective on PRM800K, while on MetaMath PPO and DPO both reach top performance and ReST gives only marginal gains over SFT. Models trained with PRM rewards using human supervision only on easy tasks reach 34.0, outperforming the previous state-of-the-art model trained across all levels (33.0), and PRM rewards are more beneficial than final-answer rewards for hard tasks.
title: PRM rewards from easy-task supervision beat prior state-of-the-art trained on all levels
